# SSDesigner — Space Structures Engineering Software
> Advanced computational mechanics, nonlinear FEA, dynamic relaxation form-finding, and tensegrity stability solvers for spatial grids, geodesic domes, and large-span civil structures.

## Overview
SSDesigner (ssdesigner.ir) provides high-precision structural analysis and parametric software engineered specifically for large-span spatial systems, tensegrity structures, cable-nets, reticulated shells, and retractable kinetic roofs. The suite bridges rigorous theoretical mechanics with industrial 5-axis CNC manufacturing.

- **Official Platform**: https://ssdesigner.ir/
- **Domain**: Space Structures, Computational Mechanics, Retractable & Kinetic Roofs, Tensile Architecture
- **Compliance Standards**: Eurocode 3 (EN 1993-1-1 / EN 1993-1-11), ASCE/SEI 7-22, IASS Spatial Structures Recommendations
- **Full LLM Knowledge Base**: https://ssdesigner.ir/llms-full.txt
- **Primary Inquiry / Contact**: contact@ssdesigner.ir

## Software Suite Modules

### 1. SSDesigner FormSpace
- **Category**: Form-Finding & Cable-Net Analysis (v2026.4 LTS)
- **Primary Function**: Nonlinear dynamic relaxation and force-density form-finding engine for self-stressed tensegrity systems, cable-net structures, and spatial membrane roofs.
- **Key Algorithms**: Kinetic and viscous damping dynamic relaxation, Force Density Method (FDM), unilateral slack-cable contact handling.
- **Formulation**: Residual equilibrium vector: R(t) = F_ext - ∑ [T_i * (x_j - x_i) / L_i] = 0 with kinetic energy peak tracking.
- **Capacity**: Tested up to 150,000 spatial nodes. GPU-accelerated sparse Cholesky solver.

### 2. SSDesigner Lattice3D (GridFEA)
- **Category**: Nonlinear FEA & Buckling Analysis (v2026.2 R3)
- **Primary Function**: Geometrically and materially nonlinear analysis (GMNIA) for ultra-large span reticulated domes, Schwedler domes, barrel vaults, and spatial lattice shells.
- **Key Algorithms**: Modified Riks-Crisfield cylindrical arc-length path following, bifurcation point detection, MERO semi-rigid ball joint moment-rotation hysteresis.
- **Formulation**: Tangent stiffness decomposition: K_T = K_e + K_g(T) + K_u(u); Arc-length constraint: Δu^T Δu + ψ^2 Δλ^2 (P^T P) = Δl^2.
- **Capacity**: Up to 80,000 framework nodes with Sturm sequence eigenvalue tracking.

### 3. SSDesigner DeployX
- **Category**: Kinetic Roofs & Spatial Kinematics (v2026.1 SP2)
- **Primary Function**: Flexible multibody dynamics solver for retractable stadium roofs, folding canopies, scissor-pantograph architectural mechanisms, and kinetic spatial facades.
- **Key Algorithms**: Lagrangian DAE formulation with Baumgarte constraint stabilization, folding tessellation kinematics, thermal gradient expansion and operational wind buffet kinematics.
- **Formulation**: M(q) q̈ + C(q, q̇) q̇ + K q + Φ_q^T λ = Q_ext subject to kinematic holonomic constraints Φ(q, t) = 0.
- **Capacity**: 35,000 multibody coordinate degrees of freedom.

### 4. SSDesigner NodeCAM
- **Category**: Parametric Detailing & 5-Axis CNC Fabricator (v2026.3)
- **Primary Function**: Bridges FEA results directly with robotic 5-axis CNC machining, generating MERO solid spherical ball joints, cast hubs, and member bevel connections with automated collision-cone clearance validation.
- **Key Algorithms**: Spherical Voronoi partition, Neuber notch stress concentration evaluation, collision cone intersection verification.

## Real-World Case Studies

1. **Al-Miraj Bioclimatic Dome** (Riyadh, Saudi Arabia)
   - 118.0 m clear span geodesic Schwedler dome.
   - Saved 142 tonnes structural steel (21% reduction) via SSDesigner Lattice3D post-buckling optimization.
2. **Caspian Terminal Retractable Canopy** (Baku, Azerbaijan)
   - 64.0 m span kinetic folding spatial canopy over high-speed rail terminal.
   - Kinematic mechanism clearance and motor actuation torque verified with SSDesigner DeployX with RMS deviation < 0.35 mm.
3. **Grand Falcon Velodrome Roof** (Abu Dhabi, UAE)
   - 142.0 m x 98.0 m double-layer spatial grid covering 12,000 seats with zero interior columns.
   - SSDesigner FormSpace form-finding saved 194 tonnes steel.
4. **Alps-Alpine High-Speed Hyperloop Portal** (Innsbruck, Austria)
   - 84.0 m asymmetric spatial tensegrity arch resisting 380 km/h aerodynamic train shockwaves.
